title: Legacy Mainframe Modernization
background: A financial services company wants to modernize a legacy mainframe that supports critical operations.
candidate_prompt: How would you evaluate the situation and recommend what the organization should do next?
good_answer_includes: Assesses legacy system pain points and business impact
Considers cost, risk, security, and user disruption
great_answer_includes: Balances technical debt reduction with business priorities
Considers architecture, data, and vendor implications
Plans transition risks and parallel operations
interviewer_notes: A strong candidate should use a clear it modernization structure, isolate the most important drivers, and connect the recommendation to business impact.
